State v.Mack Ingram, NorthCarolina SupremeCourt1953, testimony expressly dates incident June4,1951 and arrest later that morning at Simpson farm. Court text reviewed through CaseMine; page metadata February1 not accepted as actual decision date. Exact arrest day only, no custody endpoint inferred.

Smithsonian NMAAHC exhibition explicitly states Ingram was tried, convicted and imprisoned in1951 and first sentence was two years hard labor. YEAR precision only; January1 storage placeholders are not claimed dates. First two-year case matches existing record, not November1952 suspended six-month retrial sentence. No sentence length converted to time served.

National Guardian August8,1951 contemporaneously reports initial two-year sentence already imposed. First trial day/month remains uncertain; July23Time issue and laterJune15 reporting disagree, so only YEAR recorded.
